ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VeryStays uses your location to sort stations by distance, power the nearest-station widget, and watch for arrivals at busy hubs.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: VeryStays uses your location in the background to notify you when you arrive at major train stations — even when the app is closed.
